response.summary: Shares in Applied Digital slid after Nvidia said it had sold its position in the AI infrastructure provider, as well as its stakes in Arm, Recursion Pharmaceuticals and WeRide.  Nvidia disclosed in a filing late Tuesday that it no longer held shares in any of the four companies as of year end.  Shares in Applied Digital and drug-discovery company Recursion both slid more than 9%.
